mapper.select: SELECT /* IBatchLogDao.selectBatchLog */ BATCH_ID as batchId , BATCH_DT as batchDt , BATCH_STATUS as batchStatus , BATCH_HOST as batchHost , START_DT as startDt , END_DT as endDt FROM TB_LOG_BATCH WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId} AND BATCH_DT like CONCAT(#{batchDt},'%') ORDER BY START_DT DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT /* IBatchLogDao.insertBatchInitLog */ INTO TB_LOG_BATCH ( BATCH_ID , BATCH_DT , BATCH_HOST , BATCH_STATUS , START_DT , END_DT ) VALUES ( #{batchId} , #{batchDt} , #{batchHost} , 'P' , NOW() , NULL )
